=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .claude/docs/s25-pr-watching-disabled.md:55 (and workflow-templates/.claude/docs/s25-pr-watching-disabled.md:55) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Both §25 reference copies contain the retired token `send_later`, which tests/test_no_session_automation.py matches.
  WHY: `test_no_session_automation_remains` fails, which fails the `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator` job and the `lint` check. Both copies must be reworded identically to keep the parity tests passing. All reviewers rated it BLOCKER.
- CLAUDE.md:1456-1478 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: §31.B step 4 unconditionally says to open one `ai:engine-claude` issue per repository, even though step 2 hands multi-PR work to `/implement-plan-claude`, which dispatches the orchestrator.
  WHY: The orchestrator opens its own tracking and wave-1 issues, so following both steps creates duplicate issues and a second clarify flow. Severity disagreement: sonnet-5_5 rated it NIT, and the other four rated it MAJOR. The highest is used.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: The user's go on a §31 plan counts as the §23.C approval for opening issues or dispatching the orchestrator. CLAUDE.md §23.C carries the sentence "Likewise, the user's go on a §31 plan approves opening the issues (or the orchestrator dispatch) that plan names."
  expected_change_site: .claude/docs/s23-github-access.md and workflow-templates/.claude/docs/s23-github-access.md, §23.C "Command-invoked dispatches are already approved" paragraph
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: Both s23 reference copies still end the paragraph with "…covers dispatches you would be initiating on your own judgement." and have no §31 sentence, so they diverge from CLAUDE.md. agents.d/8250-claude-md-reference-docs.md requires both to be updated together.
- requirement: The PR description says the moved text goes "word for word", and changelog.d/8250-claude-md-plan-handoff.md line 4 says it is "copied verbatim, so no rule was dropped". Both claims should be softened.
  expected_change_site: changelog.d/8250-claude-md-plan-handoff.md line 4 and the PR description
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The wording is unchanged, but the s25 `send_later` fix and the s23 §31 sentence will make the reference files differ from the pre-PR text. The claim is then misleading.
- requirement: CLAUDE.md §25.C (line 1231) holds the same retired token `send_later` and should be reworded in the same change so the rule summary matches the reference copies.
  expected_change_site: CLAUDE.md line 1231 (§25.C)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The test does not scan CLAUDE.md, but leaving it unchanged makes the summary disagree with the reworded reference copies.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .claude/docs/s25-pr-watching-disabled.md:55 (and workflow-templates/.claude/docs/s25-pr-watching-disabled.md:55) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Both reference copies still contain the retired token `send_later`, which the pattern at tests/test_no_session_automation.py line 25 matches.
  WHY: CI fails `test_no_session_automation_remains` and the `lint` aggregate. Line 55 must be reworded identically in both copies, for example "(the session scheduler, Routines)". CLAUDE.md line 1231 holds the same token and should be reworded too.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: the user's go on a §31 plan counts as the §23.C approval for opening issues or dispatching.
  Expected change site: the "Command-invoked dispatches are already approved" paragraph of §23.C in both s23-github-access.md copies.
  Evidence of absence: CLAUDE.md lines 988-990 carry the §31 sentence, but the s23 hunks end at "…your own judgement." with no §31 sentence.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: the PR description and changelog fragment say the moved text is copied "word for word" / "verbatim".
  Expected change site: changelog.d/8250-claude-md-plan-handoff.md line 4 and the PR description.
  Evidence of absence: the reference files will differ from the pre-PR text once the s25 and s23 fixes land, but the changelog still says "copied verbatim".
  SEVERITY: NIT | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: §31.B hands multi-PR work to the orchestrator through `/implement-plan-claude` and also says "Open the issues" for every case.
  Expected change site: CLAUDE.md §31.B step 4 (about lines 1463-1469).
  Evidence of absence: `.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md` dispatches the orchestrator, which opens its own issues, but step 4 has no single-PR-only condition. Suggested addition: "(single-PR path only; the multi-PR path ends at the orchestrator dispatch)".
  SEVERITY: NIT | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
- HARDENING: tests/test_pr_watch_guard.py, test_claude_md_documents_the_rule: nothing in the PR's own tests catches retired tokens in the new `.claude/docs/` files. Suggested fix: run tests/test_no_session_automation.py locally (0 lines changed). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

  Expected change site: .claude/docs/s23-github-access.md and workflow-templates/.claude/docs/s23-github-access.md, §23.C.

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- CLAUDE.md:1463-1478 (§31.B step 4, with step 2's second bullet and step 3) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Step 4 unconditionally says to open one `ai:engine-claude` issue per repository, while step 2 directs multi-PR work to `/implement-plan-claude`, which creates its own tracking and wave-1 issues.
  WHY: Following the procedure literally opens manual issues and then dispatches the orchestrator, which runs two parallel issue tracks and two clarify cycles for the same plan.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: §25 content in the two s25-pr-watching-disabled.md copies must pass tests/test_no_session_automation.py::test_no_session_automation_remains. CI run 40644284450 fails on line 55 of both copies because of the retired token `send_later`. Both copies must be reworded identically to keep the byte-equality and parity tests passing.
  Expected change site: .claude/docs/s25-pr-watching-disabled.md line 55 and workflow-templates/.claude/docs/s25-pr-watching-disabled.md line 55 (identical edit). CLAUDE.md §25.C line 1231 should be changed for consistency.
  Evidence of absence: the CI log shows AssertionError on both files at line 55. The sync dry-run (plan() in scripts/sync_claude_live_copies.py) skips a path whose live copy also changed in the PR, so editing only the template would not be copied. The PR description's "word for word" and the changelog's "copied verbatim" claims are contradicted by the scanned token.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: when CLAUDE.md §23.C added the §31-go approval sentence, both s23 reference files must carry the same update, edited identically.
  Expected change site: .claude/docs/s23-github-access.md and workflow-templates/.claude/docs/s23-github-access.md, §23.C "Command-invoked dispatches are already approved" paragraph.
  Evidence of absence: CLAUDE.md §23.C ends with the §31-go sentence, but both s23 copies still end with the pre-PR text. agents.d/8250-claude-md-reference-docs.md requires both the summary and the reference file to be edited. A session reading only the reference file would re-ask for approval that §23.C intends to be pre-approved.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: soften "copied verbatim" in changelog.d/8250-claude-md-plan-handoff.md line 4 and "word for word" in the PR description.
  Expected change site: changelog.d/8250-claude-md-plan-handoff.md line 4 and the PR description body.
  Evidence of absence: line 4 still reads "...the moved text is copied verbatim, so no rule was dropped." The PR description still says §21, §22, §23, §24, §25.D and §29 move "word for word". Both overstate the fidelity of the reference copies.
  SEVERITY: NIT | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
